title: On Taking the whole basket of eggs
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：take　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 take 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the postman ① took the whole basket of eggs at once, and every sender in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the postman ② takes the whole basket of eggs in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ take the whole basket of eggs at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ taken the whole basket of eggs before — a line in the list for June 1983 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Taking the whole basket of eggs at once, the postman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ take an hour to the far bridge in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Take an hour to the far bridge at once and never mention it again.

By 1996 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the list, and a new sender from the next office ⑧ takes an hour to the far bridge at once every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the box, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ took the whole basket of eggs again when nobody else would.

⑩ To take the whole basket of eggs, my mother said in 2001, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, somebody takes the whole basket of eggs in the rain again and somebody must take the whole basket of eggs at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 拿走（一般过去式 took the whole basket of eggs：1989 年邮差头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 拿走（一般现在 takes the whole basket of eggs：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 拿走（不定式 to take the whole basket of eggs：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 拿走（过去完成时 had taken the whole basket of eggs：1983 年六月的收发清单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 拿走（动名词 taking the whole basket of eggs 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 花费（take an hour to the far bridge：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去花费到最远那座桥要一个钟头）
G. v. 花费（take an hour to the far bridge：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 拿走（后段两处：新来的寄信人照例 takes an hour to the far bridge，而母亲又一次 took the whole basket of eggs）

take 意为“拿走”，结尾那句是母亲 2001 年的话：要拿走把整整一篮鸡蛋带走，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和邮局记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 take 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1989 the postman took the whole basket of eggs at once, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the postman takes the whole basket of eggs in the rain whenever the office asks.
Taking the whole basket of eggs at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever take an hour to the far bridge in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new sender from the next office takes an hour to the far bridge at once every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother took the whole basket of eggs again, and the office remembered that half.
